business_overview.one_sentence: The Group manufactures and sells apparel labels and trim products, including hang tags, woven labels, printed labels and heat transfer products.
segments: Manufacture and sale of printing products; one reportable operating segment.
business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is recognized at point in time upon delivery of printing products; payment generally due within 30 to 90 days, new customers normally pay in advance.
business_notes: Customers are geographically diversified across Mainland China, Hong Kong, Bangladesh, India, Vietnam and other regions.
2024 revenue increase was attributed to higher sales orders from the global sales network and cost management/production efficiency.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2024 profit converted well to cash despite inventory/receivable/prepayment increases; 2023 was loss-making and capex exceeded operating cash flow. Three-year reported profit is volatile, so the owner-earnback denominator uses the 2022-2024 parent profit median before haircut and applies a further cash-profit haircut.
